'''Idonia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, she lived on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Republic, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she worked in the Equipment Requisitions area of the [[Senate Commercial District]] as a vendor of weapon modifications.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Idonia appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Modification Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Coruscant.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Idonia was removed from the game along with the rest of the Modification Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> Her position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
